exports.name: DecayOptions
exports.description:
Physics primitives (Phase 012; contracts/gesture-engine.md §5, research R4–R6). Pure functions and a small
velocity tracker: no scheduler, no DOM. Springs are NOT here — gestures use the 009 integrator
(`stepSpring`) through the 010 spring rig, so there is still one spring integrator.

props.name: power
props.description: Fraction of the release velocity carried into the motion (0–1, default 0.8).

props.name: restSpeed
props.description: Speed below which the motion rests, px/s (default 5).

props.name: timeConstant
props.description: Time constant τ in ms (50–2000, default 325).

exports.name: createGestureControls
exports.description: Create a controls object (one per controlled element; stable for its lifetime).

exports.name: createVelocityTracker
exports.description:
Release-velocity estimate from the samples of the last `windowMs` (default 100): slope between the oldest
sample in the window and the newest, minimum span 8 ms (research R4). Ring buffer, no allocation per add.

exports.name: gestureEffects
exports.description: Every physics & gesture definition in catalogue order (G01–G11), for explicit registries.

exports.name: nearestSnap
exports.description: The point of `points` nearest to `value` (`value` itself when the list is empty).

exports.name: projectDecay
exports.description:
Rest position of an exponential decay started from `value` with release `velocity` (px/s):
`value + power · velocity · τ` (research R5). Lets snap points be chosen before animating.
exports.signature: (value: number, velocity: number, options?: DecayOptions | undefined): number

exports.name: reorderMove
exports.description:
Move `item` of a list with an attached `reorder` effect by `step` positions (move up/down buttons): asks the
consumer through `onReorder`, announces the result and settles the items. No-op without the effect.
exports.signature: (list: Element, item: HTMLElement, step: number): void

exports.name: rubberband
exports.description:
Rubber band: displacement `overshoot` beyond a bound, over `dimension` px, maps to
`(1 − 1 / (|x|·c/d + 1)) · d` with the sign of `overshoot` (research R6). Continuous at 0, monotonic,
asymptotic to `dimension`.
exports.signature: (overshoot: number, dimension: number, constant?: number | undefined): number

exports.name: stepDecay
exports.description:
Advance a decay by `dt` seconds with the exact exponential solution (frame-rate independent). The state's
velocity is the CURRENT velocity (start it at `power · releaseVelocity`). Returns `true` at rest, where the
value lands on its exact projected end.
exports.signature: (state: DecayState, options: DecayOptions, dt: number): boolean

exports.name: useGestureControls
exports.description: A stable controls object for buttons and commands (the non-gesture alternatives).

exports.name: useReorderItem
exports.description: Move-up / move-down helpers for custom controls inside a `<ReorderItem>` (WCAG 2.5.7).
exports.signature: (): { moveUp: () => void; moveDown: () => void; index: number | undefined; count: number; isFirst: boolean; isLast: boolean; }

exports.name: useSpringFollow
exports.description:
G05 as a hook: a motion value that chases `source` with a spring (no React render per change). Reduced
motion jumps.
exports.signature: (source: MotionValue, spring?: SpringOptions | "gentle" | "snappy" | "bouncy" | undefined, reducedMotion?: ReducedMotion | undefined): MotionValue
